provenance.client: curl with the KakaoTalk for Mac 26.8.0 A and User-Agent headers; no account and no credential
provenance.method: Experiment WEB-LIVE-001 in research/web-error-bodies.md: fifteen single requests to katalk.kakao.com and talk-pilsner.kakao.com, either without an Authorization header or with the literal non-credential value invalid-invalid. Keys, key order, value types, numeric values, HTTP status and the content-type and talk-served-by headers are as observed. Free-text message values are replaced with synthetic text of the same language and shape; ids in request paths are synthetic.

cases.name: pilsner-gateway-401-no-authorization
cases.body: {"reason":"UNAUTHENTICATED","message":"Synthetic temporary error. Please try again later."}

cases.name: pilsner-gateway-401-invalid-authorization
cases.body: {"reason":"UNAUTHENTICATED","message":"Synthetic temporary error. Please try again later."}

cases.name: pilsner-gateway-401-prepare
cases.request: POST /messaging/files/v1/prepare with JSON body {} and no Authorization
cases.body: {"reason":"UNAUTHENTICATED","message":"Synthetic temporary error. Please try again later."}

cases.name: pilsner-gateway-401-method-not-checked-first
cases.body: {"reason":"UNAUTHENTICATED","message":"Synthetic temporary error. Please try again later."}
cases.note: The gateway rejects authentication before it checks the method.

cases.name: pilsner-gateway-401-korean-request
cases.request: GET /messaging/chats/{chatId}/bubble/reactions/{logId}/members, A mac/26.8.0/ko, Accept-Language ko, no Authorization
cases.body: {"reason":"UNAUTHENTICATED","message":"Synthetic temporary error. Please try again later."}
cases.note: The gateway message stayed English for a Korean request.

cases.name: pilsner-gateway-401-katalk-path-on-pilsner
cases.request: GET /emoticon/chat/rx/log-details?chatId={chatId}&logId={logId} on talk-pilsner with Authorization invalid-invalid
cases.body: {"reason":"UNAUTHENTICATED","message":"Synthetic temporary error. Please try again later."}

cases.name: pilsner-unknown-path-plain-text-404
cases.note: Not JSON. The talk-served-by header was absent.

cases.name: katalk-200-status-500-english-message
cases.request: POST /mac/friends/add_by_phonenumber.json, empty form body, no Authorization
cases.note: The rejection is carried on HTTP 200, so macweb.Do returns the body as success and only the endpoint decoder sees status -500.

cases.name: katalk-200-status-500-korean-message
cases.request: POST /mac/friends/add_by_phonenumber.json, A mac/26.8.0/ko, Accept-Language ko, empty form body, no Authorization
cases.note: katalk localizes message by the language in the A header.

cases.name: katalk-200-status-500-english-message-korean-a-header
cases.request: GET /mac/friends/add_by_phonenumber.json, A mac/26.8.0/ko, Accept-Language en, no Authorization
cases.note: Korean text came back although Accept-Language was en: the A header language wins. GET was accepted on this POST route.

cases.name: katalk-401-status-950-invalid-authorization
cases.request: POST /mac/friends/add_by_phonenumber.json, empty form body, Authorization invalid-invalid
cases.note: Matches the Mac client's katalk expiry marker (HTTP 401 with status -950).

cases.name: katalk-renew-200-status-500-no-message
cases.request: POST /mac/account/renew_token.json, empty form body, no Authorization

cases.name: katalk-renew-200-status-400-invalid-authorization
cases.request: POST /mac/account/renew_token.json, empty form body, Authorization invalid-invalid
cases.note: Renewal rejection is carried on HTTP 200; no refresh token was sent.

cases.name: katalk-pilsner-path-on-katalk-empty-404
cases.request: GET /emoticon/chat/rx/log-details?chatId={chatId}&logId={logId} on katalk with Authorization invalid-invalid
